items.html: And the reason is that it has already been explained that there are two coronets in Daat: one is called Hesed, and one is called Gevura. And ZA, most of him, is from the side of Hesed, and his Nukva is from the side of Gevura. Therefore the male takes all the aspect of the coronet of Hesed for himself, and nothing remains of it for his Nukva except very little, small in the extreme. And this is the reason that the Tifferet tends toward Hesed.
